description: Source code for a JavaScript/TypeScript class that generates Playwright test scripts in JavaScript, including methods for action generation, header/footer templates, and formatting utilities.

classes.name: JavaScriptLanguageGenerator
classes.description: Class that generates JavaScript code for Playwright actions and test scripts, supporting both test and standalone modes.

classes.name: JavaScriptFormatter
classes.description: Utility class for formatting JavaScript code with proper indentation and line management.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for a specific user action within a Playwright script.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates the code snippet for executing a specific action on a page element.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Produces the header part of the generated script, depending on test or standalone mode.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Produces the footer part of the generated script, including closing browser and context.

methods.name: generateTestHeader
methods.description: Creates the header for a Playwright test using '@playwright/test'.

methods.name: generateTestFooter
methods.description: Creates the footer for a Playwright test script.

methods.name: generateStandaloneHeader
methods.description: Creates the header for a standalone Playwright script.

methods.name: generateStandaloneFooter
methods.description: Creates the footer for a standalone Playwright script.

methods.name: formatOptions
methods.description: Formats options objects into code string representations.

methods.name: formatContextOptions
methods.description: Serializes browser context options, including device descriptors, into code.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the accumulated code lines into a single string with proper indentation.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Prepends text lines to the formatter's code buffer.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds lines of code to the formatter.

methods.name: newLine
methods.description: Inserts a blank line into the formatter.
